0022600095.text: The Pacers (1-0, 2nd in the Central and 7th in the East) host the Dallas Mavericks (0-1, 5th in the Southwest and 11th in the West) in Indiana's second game of the 2026-27 season. Johnny Furphy is out with a knee injury after surgery, while Aaron Nesmith (hamstring strain) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, after surgery), and Caleb Martin (thumb), Jett Howard (calf), Santi Aldama (knee) and Tarik Biberovic (heel) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the teams have not met yet this season. Indiana lost both games of the 2025-26 season series, most recently 134-130 in Indianapolis on February 22, 2026.
